Nathan Wasserman & Yoram Cohen, עלילות גילגמש – new Hebrew translation from Akkadian (Carmel, 2026)

  • Translators: Prof. Nathan Wasserman (נתן וסרמן, Hebrew University of Jerusalem) and Prof. Yoram (Yuri) Cohen (יורם כהן, Tel Aviv University). Illustrations: Miriam Wilner (מרים וילנר).
  • Publisher: Jerusalem: Carmel (הוצאת כרמל), March 2026 (תשפ"ו); 238 pp.; ISBN 978-965-7869-14-7. English subtitle: The Epic of Gilgamesh: A New Hebrew Translation from the Akkadian and a Literary Commentary.
  • Contents (from publisher TOC): פתח דבר 7; מבוא 9; רשימת הדמויות 23; שמות יישובים… 27; Tablets I–XII pp. 31–160 (Tablet XI "פנה אליו גילגמש בדברים אל אותנפישתי שבמרחקים", pp. 139–152); פרשנות ספרותית 161; לקריאה נוספת 237.
  • Price / availability (checked 2026-10-16): list price ₪118. On sale at carmelph.co.il for ₪59, and Adraba lists ₪60. E-book on e-vrit: ₪26 (was ₪54), https://www.e-vrit.co.il/Product/39117/עלילות_גילגמש. Print through e-vrit: ₪82.6.
  • URLs: https://www.carmelph.co.il/product/gilgamesh/ · HUJI CRIS record: https://cris.huji.ac.il/en/publications/עלילות-גילגמש/ · ynet interview (Itzhak Tesler, 2026): https://www.ynet.co.il/judaism/discourse/article/rjoxzonc11l
  • License / copyright: COPYRIGHTED, commercial. Only the publisher's freely posted promotional material (blurb, preface, a sample of Tablet I with line numbers, TOC) and a news article were saved. Buy the book or e-book for the actual Tablet XI text.

Files

  • carmelph.co.il--product-gilgamesh.raw.html / carmel-page--blurb-sample-toc.rtl.md: publisher page (blurb, translators' preface, vocalized sample of Tablet I ll. 1 ff., TOC).
  • ynet--Tesler-2026--interview.raw.html / ynet-article.rtl.md: ynet article with Cohen & Wasserman on the translation, Tablet XI and the Bible, and Tchernichovsky's and Shifra–Klein's earlier versions.

Line numbering

The sample shows numbered lines ("1 (מִי) רָאָה מַעֲמַקִּים…"). The translators say they edited the Akkadian themselves on the basis of George 2003 plus all fragments published since. Expect George/eBL numbering (to be verified with the book).

Name forms (from publisher page/blurb)

אותנפישתי (Ūta-napišti, without final ־ם), אתרחסיס (Atra-ḫasīs), גילגמש, אנכידו, חומבבה, אוּרוּךּ (Uruk), שַׁמְחָת (Šamḫat), אנוּ, שִידוּרי (Šiduri), שמש, נינסון, האאנה (Eanna).

Assessment

Most important comparison text for this project. It is the first Hebrew translation made by Israeli Assyriologists directly from an up-to-date Akkadian text (Wasserman also edited The Flood: The Akkadian Sources, 2020, which is saved separately in ../Wasserman-2020--The-Flood-Akkadian-Sources/). The register is deliberately contemporary Hebrew ("העברית שלנו כיום"), not pseudo-biblical, and vocalized. It is the best source for current Israeli Assyriological Hebrew name spellings. Recommended purchase: the ₪26 e-book is the cheapest.
